tutorial.title: Shrinking Flex Items
tutorial.descriptionContent: Learn how to shrink flex items with Flexbox.

lessons.title: Lesson #1
lessons.interactiveContent:
Let's learn how to make your game's HUD elements shrink inside their HUD bar when there isn't enough room.

Try out the different settings to see how shrinking works.

lessons.title: Lesson #2
lessons.interactiveContent:
HUDs that shrink are great for smaller screens. We'll mimic a smaller screen with a smaller HUD bar width.

Make sure to pick width followed by : and then 250px, ;.

lessons.title: Lesson #3
lessons.interactiveContent:
HUD panels shrink when they can't expand to their flex-basis value. Let's set flex-basis to 200px for elements of class panel.

Make sure to pick flex-basis followed by : and then 200px, ;.

lessons.title: Lesson #4
lessons.interactiveContent:
To shrink HUD panels, we use the flex-shrink property. The default value is 1.

Make sure to pick flex-shrink:, followed by 1.

lessons.title: Lesson #5
lessons.interactiveContent:
If we set the flex-shrink value to 0, then the panel doesn't shrink at all. Here, it stays at 200px, while the other panel still shrinks.

Make sure to pick 0.

lessons.title: Lesson #6
lessons.interactiveContent:
If we set both panels to flex-shrink: 0, they overflow outside of their HUD bar.

Make sure to pick 0, followed by 0.

lessons.title: Lesson #7
lessons.interactiveContent:
To make a HUD panel shrink more than others, we give it a bigger flex-shrink number. Make the first panel shrink more than the second.

Make sure to pick 2, followed by 1.

lessons.title: Lesson #8
lessons.interactiveContent:
We can set different ratios to provide different sizes for each HUD panel. To make each panel smaller than the previous one, add 1, 2, and 3.

Make sure to pick 1, followed by 2, and finally 3.

lessons.title: Lesson #9
lessons.interactiveContent: Try out different flex-direction and flex-shrink values to get a better sense of how it works.

lessons.title: Lesson #10
lessons.interactiveContent:
When do we say that a HUD panel shrinks?

When its size is less than its initial flex-basis sizeOnly when it's the same size as its text

When its size is less than its initial flex-basis size.

lessons.title: Lesson #11
lessons.interactiveContent:
What is the default flex-shrink value?

10

Make sure to pick 1.

lessons.title: Lesson #12
lessons.interactiveContent:
What happens when we set flex-shrink to 0?

The HUD panel doesn't shrink at allThe HUD panel shrinks to the size of its text

The HUD panel doesn't shrink at all.

lessons.title: Lesson #13
lessons.interactiveContent:
What does this code display?

Two HUD panels that won't shrinkTwo HUD panels that will shrink

Two HUD panels that won't shrink.

lessons.title: Lesson #14
lessons.interactiveContent:
How do we make a HUD panel shrink more than another?

By giving it a bigger flex-shrink valueBy giving it a smaller flex-shrink value

By giving it a bigger flex-shrink value.

lessons.title: Lesson #15
lessons.interactiveContent:
Tap the slider to see how the panels react. Which HUD panel has the biggest flex-shrink value?

HUD panel 3HUD panel 1

HUD panel 3.

lessons.title: Lesson #16
lessons.interactiveContent:
To make HUD panels have an initial value to shrink from, set flex-basis to 150px.

Make sure to pick 150px.

lessons.title: Lesson #17
lessons.interactiveContent:
To make sure we see the flex-shrink changes, set the HUD bar width to 250px.

Make sure to pick 250px.

lessons.title: Lesson #18
lessons.interactiveContent:
Add the shrink property and default value.

Make sure to pick flex-shrink:, followed by 1;.

lessons.title: Lesson #19
lessons.interactiveContent:
Code 0 to make the second HUD panel not shrink.

Make sure to type 0.

lessons.title: Lesson #20
lessons.interactiveContent:
Make both HUD panels overflow the HUD bar and not shrink by coding 0 as the flex-shrink value.

Make sure to pick 0, followed by 0.

lessons.title: Lesson #21
lessons.interactiveContent:
Make the second HUD panel shrink more than the first.

Make sure to pick 1, followed by 3.

lessons.title: Lesson #22
lessons.interactiveContent:
Make the first HUD panel shrink the most and the second shrink the least.

Make sure to pick 5, followed by 1.
